name: Embree Mesh Acceleration Structure
aliases: Embree-based Volume Rendering for Unstructured Meshes
definition: A wrapper around Embree (RTC) to build a triangle mesh acceleration structure and perform ray tracing (closest hit and any hit).
summary: The Embree Mesh Acceleration Structure renders unstructured meshes by converting them to triangles and using hardware-accelerated BVH traversal via Intel's Embree engine.
